decisions.executionNote: Coin is in the left workspace, bank on right. Begin left elbow-up approach with open gripper; orient toward a downward pinch.
Continue smoothly pitching the left gripper downward while advancing toward the holder; maintain elbow-up and extension margin.
Advance over the coin with conservative continuous pitch increments; final lateral and yaw alignment will use the wrist view.
Continue approaching above the holder without closing; observe coin edge before the final descent.
Align downward pinch and coin-plane yaw from the wrist view while lowering slightly; keep fingers open.
Correct yaw until the coin edge is parallel to the pinch axis and center it laterally; partially close while descending 6 mm.
Fine-center the coin at the finger meeting line and reduce remaining yaw error while closing gently.
Coin is centered between the jaws. Close fully, then lift vertically and verify separation from the holder in RGB.
Lift retained coin beyond 8 cm. Begin raising the right arm for a centered handoff while keeping each arm in its own workspace.
Coin is visibly clear of holder. Move left toward central handoff while rotating inward; raise and turn right gripper to receive.
Bring both grippers toward their respective sides of the central handoff; left stays closed around the visible coin.
Slow the donor's inward rotation to preserve joint continuity. Receiver approaches the handoff with open fingers, without crossing center.
Prepare receiving jaw tilt and stop short of the coin. Continue donor orientation slowly to avoid wrist-joint jumps.
Continue controlled inward donor approach with coin retained. Receiver remains open and stationary.
Advance the coin toward receiver center and finish horizontal handoff orientation in small steps.
Last suffix was rejected at the wrist continuity limit. Replan from observed pose with half-sized inward and rotation increments.
Complete the central handoff alignment with small steps. Receiving fingers remain open as the two tips approach the coin.
Coin is at the receiving jaws. Fine-center the right gripper laterally and close around the opposite coin edge while left retains it.
Secure the right grasp fully before opening the donor. Keep both arm poses fixed during transfer.
Open donor fully and separate hands. Right retains the visible coin; begin a conservative turn toward the bank while left retreats.
Right coin retention is visible after separation. Progress toward above-bank pose with small wrist rotations; return left arm toward origin.
Right wrist continuity guard rejected the suffix. Replan with 3 mm and 0.018 rad increments, coin held closed; left continues its clear return path.
Continue rightward bank approach with retained coin and conservative wrist pitch. Left follows a smooth elbow-up return arc.
Carry coin toward the bank while increasing downward orientation gradually. Continue left return without crossing workspaces.
Finish left return. Bring right hand closer above the bank, pitching the retained coin downward while maintaining clearance.
Maintain coin clearance while bringing the right gripper nearer vertical above the bank. Left settles at origin.
Move above the slot estimated from head RGB, completing the downward coin orientation. Hold above the bank for wrist alignment.
Align coin-plane yaw with the visible slot and correct a small lateral offset while holding above the bank.
Slot is now visible behind the coin. Remove the remaining small yaw mismatch and descend 1 cm slowly, keeping the coin closed in the gripper.
Coin edge is centered and parallel to the slot. Lower another 15 mm in small vertical steps, holding alignment fixed.
Coin remains centered in the slot opening. Seat a final 6 mm, then start opening the gripper without lateral motion.
Open completely and hold the aligned pose, allowing the coin to drop into the slot before retreating.
Coin disappeared into the aligned slot after opening. Retreat the empty right gripper smoothly and return both arms to origin.
Continue the empty right-arm return arc, maintaining elbow-up and clearance from the bank; correct the small left home-orientation residual.
Continue the smooth right-arm return toward home with the gripper open; the slot remains clear of the released coin.
Decelerate into the right origin pose with continuous elbow-up motion and open gripper.
